verdict.rationale: Mastra's docs explicitly state agents can load tools from remote MCP servers to expand capabilities, directly matching the story of plugging in MCP servers so the product can use their tools. This is documented first-party but lacks independent/hands-on corroboration or detail on the connection setup process; missing for 10: independent/hands-on confirmation of MCP client usage, more detail on configuration/auth for connecting remote MCP servers.
